8a5d54f09493.summary: Researchers have shown that multiple time crystals inside a semiconductor can synchronize their oscillations, much like pendulum clocks gradually falling into the same rhythm. The discovery reveals surprisingly long-range connections between these exotic spin systems and could help researchers develop future spin-based devices.

The unexpected result points to a hidden cellular role that could help explain why people respond differently to certain leukemia treatments.
